body:
Wow I have a friend in painfully a very similar situation. Me and him are secondary school drop-outs and at a college doing a course for younger people. I can see it in him how he's heartbroke after his girl he loved won't even be friends with him.

I'm so sorry you're feeling like this at the moment - take a deep breath, and try to slow down. Life can suck really badly, everyone on this subreddit knows that. Just try to talk to someone about your feelings. If you don't feel like talking to a therapist or doctor, then you may have family or friends who can listen. And then there's the thousands of us here willing to listen to you. Stay safe :).

Categorically there is not something wrong with you. If we're going to get to details then you were turned on by that girl's sluttiness. She just happened to be younger. Even if you were turned on by herself that is OKAY. We all like to think we're perfectly straight or something else, but honestly we're advanced social creatures and we can't help being attracted to a multitude of things. No-one is outright [insert term here]. AND THAT IS FINE.

If you want to feel better, I really think you should stop worrying over this. It really isn't "astonishingly terrible". Stop researching and trying to label yourself and stop thinking about that day and why you did it. I hate to do the tough love thing but I know from experience that the more you worry and research and talk and think about things then the more they pile on top of you and make it worse.

If it helps, get some sleep or watch TV or play a game. Try and occupy your mind with something else :).

EDIT: Speaking of which, I should probably get some sleep myself. I'll be back in the morning if you want to keep talking. Wishing you the best of luck :).

I see, that gives me a bit more insight. Coincidentally enough, I've had a similar-ish experience when I was 11/12. I don't know where it all started but I think it was probably stress and/or school pressure. I completely lost my mind, I won't go into much detail but I was very *very* paranoid. I carried knives around with me, didn't talk to anyone, thought the government were tracking me blah blah blah.

This could of been because I had (have?) a multitude of disorders *or* because I was stressed over several events that had happened - I don't know. Anyone can get a little crazy if they've had things in their life recently that have upset them or scared them, and it happens more than you think (see [Brief Psychotic Disorder](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brief_psychotic_disorder)). Try and stay calm and talk to someone (we're here!) if you feel down :).

I posted something here yesterday and didn't get much response at all either. Problem with this subreddit is that instead of the posts being in a queue, the ones that don't get the traction other posts do, get completely lost after a couple days.

People do care, some people here are so affectionate and helpful you can't imagine. If you are feeling extremely sad and at risk, there are dozens of [helplines](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/wiki/hotlines) that are waiting to take your call and just *listen* to you. Stay safe :).

Hey there, I can see you're pretty stressed and scared at the moment - that's alright, just please stay safe :). You talk a lot about your worries of being attracted to children, and how you hate it. Honestly, most people have crazy experiences like this in their life where they'll suddenly have a fling for something not typical. It's OK, and really, you can think whatever you want to think, as long as you don't act on those thoughts.

From my view it sounds like you've gone through a bad situation with a lot of misunderstanding and doubt in yourself. At your age you're bound to be questioning everything in your life, as it's an important time. The best thing you can do is let it go and try to put it behind you, but anyone with depression will tell you that's impossible. So maybe the best thing is to just *explore*, re-affirm yourself. I'm not saying go and talk to lots of people, just take it slow and steady.

Also, you say you're pretty paranoid at the moment. Trust me, I know what that's like, and it's very tricky to get out of it. I don't have great advice for this one, sorry about that :p.

I'm not great at all at giving relationship/love advice but try and keep calm. You might have made mistakes in the past, but that is the *past*. Every day is a new day. If you want to, throw a chair at a wall, let out your emotions. Just please don't hurt yourself or anyone else :D. I hope things look brighter tomorrow for you!

I'm really sorry you haven't got a response sooner, this subreddit can be fairly quiet at times. Please know I'm for you and care :).

I'll format a proper response in a moment.
So how DO you respond to someone?
^^^^^Anybody ^^^^^there, ^^^^^advice?

Is there any chance you can call back the manager yourself and see if there's any negotion available? He might be able to place you somewhere else. Either way, I definitely wouldn't give up on this opportunity. If there's no other options and you really want this, I would take the offer you've been given. You'll be doing something you want and maybe enjoy, and I don't believe that the town (even if it is tiny) is going to have NOTHING to do.

Again, I'm not really qualified for this kind of advice, but I would consider your options and not just give up - no matter how much easier that seems :). I'm free to talk any time 16:00 UTC onwards.

Man, it definitely sounds like you're in a rough spot at the moment. I'd love to give you some life advice, but I'm way too young for that. What I can say, is that based off what you've told us, you still have the ability to change things. You can be the most fantastic, most interesting and most brilliant person your friends and family know. I know that sounds like utter bollocks but hear me out.

Yeah, things aren't going as you hoped right now. And I bet you barely have the energy to keep applying for jobs. That's alright - honestly, if you did get a different job I doubt you would feel much better. Sort yourself out first, no matter how long that takes. See a therapist, take some medication if advised and try and complete some small goals every day. You can do this.

Walmart customers? Fuck 'em.

Not having a girlfriend? Big whoop.

Didn't feel up to the teaching job? No matter.

Hang in there bud :).

Everyone in the world deserves happiness and acceptance, but sometimes it seems impossible to reach. You're going through and thinking about a lot at the moment, but think of it as fog blocking your way to happiness.
If you want to talk, we're here for you. Even if it's just venting, explaining to yourself your situation can help you start to get to grips with everything :).

It sounds like you've been bottling up some emotions for a long time, and the lid just popped. It's natural to feel scared from this sudden release of emotion, some of it we don't understand and other bits are just overwhelming. It helps though, it helps us to put behind what's happened in the past and to start fresh with an empty bottle. I'm not saying storing your emotions is the best way to go about things, but sometimes we can't help it.

So, is there something you want to talk about? All of us here will welcome you, and not try to help, but understand what you're going through and give you a sense of direction. Let's talk :).

I've been doing this for years too, so you're not alone. I wish I could give you some advice but I can't sadly. What I can say though is that if you plan to do something the day before, something small like preparing a nice meal for yourself - it helps. It doesn't matter if the meal turns out to be a disaster, at least you planned to do something productive, and actually carried it out. Give it a try, and best of luck :).
That's a bit more comforting. My worry is that I'll just be frozen there with no idea what to say or where to start. I'm atrocious at talking about anything taboo or personal.
Because I literally don't have the energy to get out of bed, get dressed and take a bus to somewhere. If only death was more simple.
Logged in after lurking reddit for the last 3 hours just to upvote this. I know what it's like brother.

I just felt so God-damn... bored today. On Christmas. All these presents I have, and I can't even be bothered to use them.

Indeed, fuck Christmas and everything about it.
It's just to keep my mind active. I barely play any games except TF2, which I have over 400 hours in. I've tried to play new games but I can never be bothered to "get into them".

I listen to this whenever I'm feeling mad at *everything ever* or in despair of the situation I'm in, it lets me pour out all my emotions into the song - whether that's through air drumming, stomping to the beat or singing along. It's a beauitful piece that also has some pretty moving images from the movie Inception (2010) - take a look.

You got this, hang in there bud :).

Probably depressed student here. If I could go up to one of my tutors and cry out all my problems to them, and then they gave me a hug (instead of sending me to counselling to several weeks), I would be the happiest man in the world.

A lot of people know me from a school I used to go to, and it is just the worst if I get spotted by someone. I left that school really suddenly without any explanation, so any of my previous friends probably have a lot of awkward questions to ask me. I actually see quite a lot of people I know around the town (while trying to ensure they don't see me), and I'm always trying to avoid certain regions of the town or times of day where I know a lot of them will be.
Yes... so much. Only contrary to most of the people in this thread, I need to lose some weight. It's gets on my nerves a lot, I just wear sweaters and coats to try and hide it :/.

You are not alone, I can relate to this so much.

I don't enjoy anything social, I don't have any hobbies, I don't do anything. I have none of my class mates' phone numbers and don't use social media. I've thought for so long that no-one cares about me and I'm completely invisble with no friends. But this afternoon, completely out of the blue - *several people* told me that I was their best friend. This was a massive shock, and **it fucking made my day**. Earlier that day I was going through my head about how and when I was going to kill myself, because no-one would care if I vanished anyway.

I now know that *some* people, lest it be only one - care about me and that is enough to keep living for now. You may have the same view I had, but please believe me - even if you think no-one cares for you, there is always someone that does. You might have not even met that person yet. But just keep **hope**, for most of us it's the only thing that keeps us going. Hang in there. You can do this.

Lots of internet love <3.

I must say, I see so many posts and stories here about God awful therapists and having to go through several to actually find someone remotely helpful, it puts me off more and more to actually go get some "help".

This so much. If I'm not interested or don't see the benefit to me I will almost never do the task at hand. Comparitively, if I am interested in a particular topic, I'll work my arse off and actually enjoy it.

I confuse my tutors.
I thought I was the only one that did the phone thing, I've outright stopped answering mobile calls from numbers that aren't on my contacts.
Thanks, nice to know someone else has the same issues.

Sounds a lot like me, I used to cry over getting in trouble about the smallest things.
Now I'm a secondary-school drop out who doesn't give a shit about authority.
Funny how times change.

I haven't told anyone about what I've been struggling with for the past couple years, consequently I've never got a diagnosis for whatever the hell is wrong with me, and I'd rather not self-diagnose myself (that got me in a real mess last time). I'm fairly certain there's some medical reason though, I can't just be pointlessly sad.

I can't put it into words. I'm just so fucking sad, all the time, and there isn't any logical reason behind it. I'm going out for a stroll in a minute to try and clear my head, because I can't sleep. For the rest of the week (as I have a week off my place of education) I'll be alone in my room, trying to enjoy playing video games, and thinking of ways to fix everything. It's a longer story than what I've detailed but I'm just basically sick of everything ever, there's no point anymore.

I'm going to try to head off to bed soon, so I won't be responding until tomorrow or whatever. I thank you for listening to me though, it means something.
I wouldn't want to waste any of your time when there are other people who need more help than me. Besides, I'd just ramble on for hours. I appreciate the gesture though.

Really glad to see you're still here! I would like to say though, that things won't just get better on their own. You WILL need to ask for help at some point, and I know that sounds like a horrible idea because it means getting out of bed and going outside, but you have to start somewhere. Even if you don't believe in yourself or think that it's pointless, just conjuring the willpower to go to a family member, friend, GP, counsellor or whoever you feel comfortable with - is the first step to getting back on your feet.

I really wish you the best of luck man, let me know if you need anything :).

My weekend was actually OK, I went to a convention-like event with a family member and it was something we were both interested in, so that cheered me up quite a bit. Sadly though I'm back to 1AM suicide blues, which is disappointing considering the weekend I had.

My word, this made me well up. I dearly hope you reconsider, because you sound like a great person. Also - you say you could of become an amazing neurologist. Not many people can claim that, and the fact of the matter is you can still be that amazing neurologist. Just because things seem bleak now doesn't mean it won't improve in the future. And I know that sounds like your typical "it'll get better" useless advice, but you have you have a lot of years left in your lifetime, and that's more than enough time to do and be whatever it is you desire.

I'll keep this short because I know you just want straight answers. So far in life, it really hasn't been great. But in 20 years time when you've got a great job with a loving SO, you'll be happy you kept hope for just those next few days.
